correctness.rationale: For fixed k>=2, each nonconstant (k-1)-factor is unique since a second distinct-letter bigram would yield abab. Homogeneous repeated vertices arise only in a-runs, and the 2k-2 bound makes homogeneous-loop placement forced and prevents productive triple returns. Two different repeated homogeneous vertices cannot interleave, by noncrossing. Endpoint-fixed Euler-trail uniqueness, supplemented by a sharp 2k-1 collision, proves the all-length result. Direct exhaustive profile collisions and independent RGF counts passed for stated bounded ranges.

value.rationale: A structural, all-read-length sharp condition (2k-2 occurrences per label, with explicit 2k-1 obstruction) converts the well-motivated noncrossing partition source into a globally identifiable code. It yields exact all-length zero-error capacity for every max-block partition source via a natural algebraic series. This advances beyond a single finite census, a trivial known table, or the previously checked k=2 special case.
